title: Pollo a la Brasa
subtitle: Peruvian Roast Chicken

items: 3–4 lb whole chicken, spatchcocked, or 4–6 bone-in thighs

ingredientGroups.title: Marinade
items: 6 garlic cloves, minced to a paste
2 Tbsp lime juice or white vinegar
Optional: ½ tsp ají panca chili powder

ingredientGroups.title: Ají Verde
items: 1 cup fresh cilantro, including tender stems
2 Tbsp sour cream or Greek yogurt

steps: Blend the marinade ingredients until smooth.
Blend the ají verde ingredients until smooth. Adjust the lime and salt, then chill for 30 minutes before serving.
Coat the chicken with the marinade. Refrigerate overnight, or up to 3 days.
Grill skin-side up over indirect heat at 375–400°F until the chicken reaches 150°F internally.
Move the chicken skin-side down over direct heat. Grill until it reaches 160–165°F internally.
Rest for 15 minutes before carving. Serve with ají verde.
sourceNote: Great when grilled over wood to pick up a smoked flavor. Serve with roasted potatoes and ají verde. Adapted from https://silkroadchef.com/2017/12/25/uzbek-plov-lamb-rice-pilaf-in-instant-pot/
